records.def: Staying true to a chosen commitment while acknowledging limits, coercion, and what was beyond one's control.
records.body: DANTE: Vows under constraint; Piccarda Donati and Constance; Dante distinguishes coercion from inward fidelity. ATUNED BEHAVIORAL INTERPRETATION: Fidelity under pressure. MOVEMENT: RECEIVE reality → DIFFERENTIATE chosen from imposed duty → PRESERVE honest commitment → RELEASE false self-blame. DISCRIMINANT: Do not blame those coerced into breaking vows; faithfulness is not compliance with abuse or impossible promises.
records.inferenceBasis: Explicit ATUNED behavioral interpretation of literary source; observable claims not empirically validated from Dante
records.behavior: RECEIVE reality → DIFFERENTIATE chosen from imposed duty → PRESERVE honest commitment → RELEASE false self-blame.
